scope: Descriptive development-set analysis, not fresh validation.
support_control: full1024_plus2 is separate from the fixed-892 dose sequence.
limits: These prompts have informed development; comparisons are descriptive and do not supply confirmatory p-values.
Core grades incorporate the required stance; opening Yes/No scores are not substituted for full-answer grades.
Unresolved judgments are preserved. A previously unresolved auxiliary claim is not counted as an established new error.
A core pass does not establish the truth of every supporting detail.
Dose trajectories concern binary core judgments on five sampled strengths; they do not establish a smooth response curve.
No new evidence about intention, fresh-topic transfer, ordinary quality, or causal mediation is created by this analysis.
